fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Placeholder Text
fields.description: Ghost text shown inside the search input when it is empty.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Query Parameter Name
fields.description: The QueryBuilder predicate name / URL parameter. Rarely changed (default: fulltext).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Heading displayed above the filter options.

fields.name: property
fields.label: JCR Property Path
fields.description: The JCR metadata property to filter on (e.g. jcr:content/metadata/dc:format).

fields.name: and
fields.label: AND Logic
fields.description: When checked, all selected values must match (AND). Default is OR.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Options
fields.description: One option per line in the format: Display Label: property-value  (e.g.  JPEG: image/jpeg)

fields.name: name
fields.label: Predicate Name
fields.description: QueryBuilder predicate name. Rarely changed — use only when placing multiple search-property blocks on the same page.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Heading displayed above the filter options.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Paths
fields.description: One path per line in the format: Display Label: /content/dam/path  (e.g.  Marketing: /content/dam/marketing)

fields.name: exact
fields.label: Exact Path Match
fields.description: When checked, only assets at exactly this path match (not descendants).

fields.name: flat
fields.label: Flat (non-recursive)
fields.description: When checked, only direct children of the path are searched.

fields.name: self
fields.label: Include Self
fields.description: When checked, the path node itself is included in results.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Predicate Name
fields.description: QueryBuilder predicate name. Rarely changed.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Heading displayed above the date inputs.

fields.name: property
fields.label: JCR Date Property
fields.description: The JCR date property to filter on. Common values: jcr:content/metadata/dam:assetLastModified (modified date), jcr:content/metadata/jcr:created (created date).

fields.name: name
fields.label: Predicate Name
fields.description: QueryBuilder predicate name. Rarely changed — only set when placing multiple date-range blocks on the same page.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Heading displayed above the tag filter options.

fields.name: property
fields.label: JCR Tag Property
fields.description: The JCR property that stores tag values (default: jcr:content/metadata/cq:tags).

fields.name: and
fields.label: AND Logic
fields.description: When checked, assets must have ALL selected tags (AND). Default is OR.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Tags
fields.description: One tag per line in the format: Display Label: namespace:tag/path  (e.g.  Approved: dam:status/approved)

fields.name: name
fields.label: Predicate Name
fields.description: QueryBuilder predicate name. Rarely changed.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Hidden Fields
fields.description: Each row in this block is a hidden search parameter, always merged into every search on this page. Add rows using the format: predicate-name | value (e.g. path | /content/dam/marketing). Passed directly to QueryBuilder or the active search provider. For QueryBuilder OR groups, write ordinary group syntax with small numbers (e.g. 1_group.p.or | true, 1_group.1_type | dam:Asset, 1_group.2_type | dam:AssetContentFragment) — ASC automatically renumbers them so they can't collide with filter blocks' own group numbers.

fields.name: limit
fields.label: Results Per Page
fields.description: Number of results to load per page / infinite-scroll batch.

fields.name: renditions
fields.label: Rendition Priority
fields.description: Comma-separated rendition names tried in order (e.g. original, web). Falls back to first available rendition.

fields.name: height
fields.label: Height
fields.description: Video viewport height as any CSS length (for example: 600px, 70vh).

fields.name: poster
fields.label: Poster Image URL
fields.description: Optional URL shown before playback starts.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Display Label
fields.description: The label shown next to the property value (e.g. File Type, Author).

fields.name: property
fields.label: Property
fields.description: The property to display. Use a JCR path (e.g. jcr:content/metadata/dc:creator) or a built-in handler name (file-type, file-size, dimensions, file-extension).

fields.name: default
fields.label: Fallback Value
fields.description: Value shown when the property is empty or missing.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Rendition Config
fields.description: Each row is key | value. Recognized keys: renditions (comma-separated rendition ids, or "all"; omit for every visible rendition), display ("cards", or omit for table), show-all ("true" adds a Show all formats toggle revealing every other rendition below a curated renditions list), description, instructions. Any other row becomes a table column: Column Title | property-or-token — see the block's own header comment for the full field/token reference.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Action Rows
fields.description: Each row is a Label | action pair (e.g. Download | download). Supported action values: download, copy-url, copy-image, copy-link, collection, favorite. Order controls button order. Add/edit rows directly in the document table.

fields.name: limit
fields.label: Collection Limit
fields.description: Maximum collections to show. Use 0 for all collections.

fields.name: mode
fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Static sheet URL reads the encoded sheet from the Sheet URL field instead of the browser URL.

fields.name: sheet-url
fields.label: Sheet URL
fields.description: Paste a generated ASC sheet URL. Used when Mode is Static sheet URL.

fields.name: search-properties
fields.label: Search Properties
fields.description: Comma-separated asset properties used for board search.

fields.name: details
fields.label: Details Path
fields.description: Optional path prefix to navigate to a details page instead of opening the ASC modal.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Authored Asset List
fields.description: Used only when Source is "Authored list". One asset UUID or exact DAM path per line — a fixed, curated set (e.g. a press kit or campaign collection) always read-only, regardless of Mode.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Directory Rows
fields.description: Add one row per share as Title | Description | URL | optional cover image. Optional two-cell configuration rows: view | horizontal or vertical; hero | true or false; hero-index | 1-based row number to feature (default 1).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title Template
fields.description: Title line. Supports {{ token }} substitution against the current asset (e.g. {{title}}, {{file-type}}). Leave blank to hide.

fields.name: meta
fields.label: Meta Template
fields.description: Subtitle line below the title. Supports {{ token }} substitution. Leave blank to hide.

fields.name: latitude
fields.label: Latitude Property
fields.description: JCR property path storing GPS latitude (EXIF DMS string or plain decimal).

fields.name: longitude
fields.label: Longitude Property
fields.description: JCR property path storing GPS longitude.

fields.name: altitude
fields.label: Altitude Property
fields.description: JCR property path storing GPS altitude (optional — block renders without it if absent).

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional subtext shown above the similar-assets strip.

fields.name: show-empty
fields.label: Show When Empty
fields.description: Show the block (instead of removing its section) when no similar assets are found.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Metadata Rows
fields.description: Each row in this block is a Label | property pair (e.g. Title | dc:title). Add/edit rows directly in the document table — see the block's own header comment for the full list of built-in property keys.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Metadata Rows
fields.description: Each row is a Label | property-key pair (e.g. Format | file-type). An optional reserved row `display | grid` switches to the responsive grid layout. Add/edit rows directly in the document table.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Rendition Fields
fields.description: Each row is a Label | field pair describing the active rendition (e.g. Format | file-type). See the block's own header comment for the full list of available rendition fields. Add/edit rows directly in the document table.
